title: Full Creative Control Within Brief
tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

judge.summary: A charming six-second animated clip shows a tiny robot pouring water onto a potted sunflower’s soil, with no obvious visible defects.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
must_haves.why: One output video is provided and identified as six seconds long.

must_haves.item: A tiny robot is visibly present.
must_haves.why: A small teal robot is clearly visible beside the flowerpot, shorter than the sunflower.

must_haves.item: A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
must_haves.why: The plant has a large dark seed head surrounded by bright yellow petals.

must_haves.item: The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.
must_haves.why: The robot holds and tips a watering can, with a visible stream landing on the soil around the sunflower’s stem.
